summary: A pointer drag on a layer, from the press to one committed step, with the UV outline following every frame and the 3D view following each raster.

steps.does: A press on the UV canvas or the head, then moves coalesced to one per animation frame.
Asks the view's editor runtime what is under the pointer, within the cycle.
Answers with the layer and point or shape hit.
Checks the gesture against the preset's capability in the same cycle.
Opens the window's one gesture on the preset and layer.
Records the latest frame; nothing is kept per frame.
Turns the frame into edits of the layer's keys over the working copy.
Sees a change reported for that layer only, and asks for its raster at the current tier (latest wins; the running job for the layer is cancelled).
Rasters the layer in the worker and returns the bundle by reference.
Publishes the complete bundle for the raster key.
Changes, so the plate rebuilds in the scene's next draw.
Draws every visible view whose scene wears the preset.
On release, records one look step labelled by the first frame that changed anything.
Appends the one commit and waits for its acknowledgement.

demand: Every visible view and flat editor showing the preset; during the drag, the gesture's own consumers.

faults.when: The layer was removed in another window during the drag.
The layer's fine glitter lies outside the eye region.

latency: The UV outline follows every frame.
The 3D texture follows as soon as the worker finishes: the 2K reference recipe rasters in about 0.97 s for all layers.
budget.memory: Rasters up to 4096² per layer live on the GPU by reference; the working copy is the preset's value plus one frame of edits.

invariants: Exactly one committed step results from a drag, and none from a drag that changed nothing.
Escape leaves the preset exactly as before the press, with no step and no redo.
Only complete raster bundles are ever shown.
Only the dragged layer is re-rastered.
One gesture at most is open per window.

x-friction.gap: The drag's frames are edits every consumer must see before any commit.
x-friction.closes: Uncommitted edits collapsed into one commit or dropped.
